method: Sequential MILP with Hamming-distance cuts on occupied bet sets; portfolios repeating an accepted sorted 37-pocket P&L multiset are discarded. All portfolios exactly re-settled; no Monte Carlo.
limitations: One-spin, fair European wheel, integer chips, no table limits or denomination rules. Solver status 'optimal' is numerical HiGHS evidence, 'limit' means best found within the time limit. Lists are best-found distinct alternatives, not an exhaustive enumeration, and a time-limited cell may miss better portfolios. Every portfolio has expectation exactly -stake/37; a higher winning frequency is not an edge.

cells.objective_text: highest winning frequency (then smallest worst loss)
